description: Which default category does this flow belong to? auth: signing in, signing up, signing out, passwords and sessions. browse: viewing pages and records. create-edit: creating or changing the app's records. search: searching, filtering, sorting, finding. settings: the user's own account and preferences. admin: managing other users or the whole system.

auth: Log in with email and password
Sign up for a new account
Verify email address from the confirmation link
Enter a two-factor code at login
browse: View the archive of past games
create-edit: Add a product to the catalog
Upload a document to a project
Write and publish a blog post
Create a new game and share its code
search: Search for a user by email
Find a game by its code
Use autocomplete to find a city
settings: Connect a GitHub account in settings
Change the theme to dark mode
Manage API keys for my account
admin: Admin impersonates a user for support
